## Azure Communication Services  
  
<!--6a24a577-06be-44d1-8883-df8f2b1cf2a1_begin-->

#### Prepare for Azure Communication Services breaking changes and service retirement by July 31st, 2028  
  
Your Azure Communication Services resources are using services that will be retired or experience breaking changes effective March 31st, 2029. Services with breaking changes will require integration with Teams, D365, or Copilot for continued support. Retired services will be completely unavailable.  
  
**Potential benefits**: Prevent future ACS service disruption  

**Impact:** High
  
For more information, see [Sign in to your account](https://aka.ms/acs-retirement-and-breaking-changes-guide)
